WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) = 2020
    GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE))
)
SELECT * FROM monthly_balances LIMIT 10;
SELECT txn_type, COUNT(*), SUM(txn_amount) FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions GROUP BY txn_type

WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance_literal,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type IN ('withdrawal', 'purchase') THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance_all
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) = 2020
    GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE))
)
SELECT 
    month,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN month_end_balance_literal > 0 THEN 1 END) AS pos_literal,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN month_end_balance_all > 0 THEN 1 END) AS pos_all
FROM monthly_balances
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

args.sql:
WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance_literal,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 ELSE -txn_amount END) AS month_end_balance_all
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) = 2020
    GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE))
)
SELECT 
    month,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN month_end_balance_literal > 0 THEN 1 END) AS pos_literal,
    AVG(month_end_balance_literal) AS avg_literal,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN month_end_balance_all > 0 THEN 1 END) AS pos_all,
    AVG(month_end_balance_all) AS avg_all
FROM monthly_balances
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH monthly_net AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS net_literal,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_all
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) = 2020
    GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(txn_date AS DATE))
),
cumulative_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        SUM(net_literal) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS cum_literal,
        SUM(net_all) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS cum_all
    FROM monthly_net
)
SELECT 
    month,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cum_literal > 0 THEN 1 END) AS pos_cum_literal,
    AVG(cum_literal) AS avg_cum_literal,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cum_all > 0 THEN 1 END) AS pos_cum_all,
    AVG(cum_all) AS avg_cum_all
FROM cumulative_balances
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
